title: portulaca pilosa subsp. sundaensis
intro: Portulaca pilosa subsp. sundaensis, commonly known as Sundanese purslane, is a plant species belonging to the family Portulacaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine in Indonesia, particularly in the Sundanese region, to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Sundanese purslane include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of fever, colds, and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of Portulaca pilosa subsp. sundaensis include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as antipyretic, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory effects.
